bluf: BBC News World reported that the Crimean Bridge partly collapsed; Ukraine said a missile and drone attack on the bridge took weeks to plan. Trump arrived in China and was greeted by Xi ahead of a planned trilateral meeting with Putin at APEC.

cyber.text: BleepingComputer reported that attackers are exploiting a critical Apache Roller flaw to gain code execution on vulnerable servers; Apache released security updates.
The Record reported that a Kazakh ransomware hacking suspect was extradited from Italy; the U.S. accused him of participating in attacks against healthcare organizations, schools and companies.

items.text: BBC News World reported a partial collapse of the Crimean Bridge; Ukraine said a missile and drone attack on the strategic bridge took weeks to plan.

Trump arrived in China and was greeted by Xi, ahead of a planned trilateral meeting with Putin on the sidelines of APEC. Deutsche Welle cited differing priorities on trade, Ukraine, Iran and arms control.
CBC Calgary reported that TC Energy plans to expand its Alberta pipeline network, initially adding one billion cubic feet per day of capacity to serve natural gas demand.
BBC News World reported that Secretary of State Marco Rubio said there was zero evidence linking recent disruptions affecting Microsoft, banks and flights.
